subject.title: Sessions panel: sort by last meaningful activity, not just last message

question: Should the Sessions panel default ordering use the existing `lastActivityAt` field, and should child-session activity roll up at read time or through stored parent-row updates?
rationale: Current main has the raw material for denoised activity, but the taxonomy, rollup behavior, and storage/projection strategy affect session-state semantics and hot-path write/read load.

options.title: Use read-time projection
options.body: Sort by a derived activity key from `lastActivityAt` plus recent child rows and expose a reason label without rewriting parent rows for every child event.

options.title: Persist a rollup field
options.body: Add a stored meaningful-activity sort key with tests for every qualifying event and an explicit migration/write-load plan.

options.title: Keep updatedAt ordering
options.body: Leave Sessions ordering as pinned/updated recency and document `lastActivityAt` only as unread-state metadata.

recommendation.title: Use read-time projection
recommendation.body: Sort by a derived activity key from `lastActivityAt` plus recent child rows and expose a reason label without rewriting parent rows for every child event.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Sessions UI grouping and unread-state changes make this the best available owner for the UX/product choice.
